newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Gudang Garam down on expected 1997 slow growth.
newsitem.headline: Gudang Garam down on expected 1997 slow growth.

text.p: Shares in Indonesia's largest cigarette maker PT Gudang Garam fell sharply in late trading on Tuesday because of expected slow growth in 1997 and overall weak market sentiment, brokers and analysts said.
Gudang Garam fell 475 rupiah to 10,725 rupiah with around one million shares traded.
"Last year was the Gudang Garam year. The firm increased prices while the government introduced a tax which somewhat benefitted the firm," an analyst with a foreign brokerage firm said.
One broker said overall weak market sentiment was also seen prompting sales of Guomment on the firm's expected performance.
The analyst said he was cautious whether the firm was able to maintain its expected strong 1996 performance in 1997 after raising prices in 1996.
The analyst said he expected the firm to book a net profit of some 623 billion rupiah in 1996 against 366.47 billion rupiah in 1995.
A Gudang Garam official declined to comment on the firm's expected performance.
